title: Add CookwareView
description: Create CookwareView.swift. Displays a list of Recipe.cookware items. Each row shows the cookware name on the leading edge and its quantity (if any) on the trailing edge. No checkboxes, no scaling. Empty state shows 'No cookware listed' centered.
acceptance_criteria: Each row shows cookware name leading and optional quantity trailing.
Empty state 'No cookware listed' shown when Recipe.cookware is empty.
